_about: #910 phase 1 (PR 3): the operating systems network gear states about itself, each one the software the matcher compares (modules/findings networkos.go, INV-4c). One row per OS: statement = the whole OS value as Vedette records it (capture.ParseSysDesc for sysDescr/LLDP, sensor-active for the FortiGate ENTITY-MIB firmware), group 1 its version; the statement that counts is the device's own answer to Vedette's SNMP read of its address, which always wins; lldp_oui (Junos only: the EX4200 states its OS only over LLDP) also reads an LLDP statement when there is no SNMP answer and the device's MAC at its address has that IEEE vendor (review r1 H1 of #919); scheme = how the version orders against NVD: junos (maintenance trains, junosEval), dotted (numbers, an optional letter: generic comparison), none (not orderable, classic Cisco IOS 15.2(4)M3: never compared, listed as not comparable); cpe = NVD part:vendor:product; kev_keys = the CISA KEV vendor|product keys (lower case) that name this OS, with the vendor's Multiple Products. A version the scheme cannot read gives a not-comparable row too. Order matters: the first row whose statement matches wins (IOS XE before IOS). Checked by TestNetworkOS_DataIsValid against kev-products.json.
